decisions.reason: The medical examination light extends the established offer, fits the announced LED direction and carries sunk development and certification costs, so with no clear evidence of failure management persists with it.
The certified explosion-proof industrial line represents heavy certification investment and is central to the firm's industrial customer focus, making withdrawal very unlikely.
The designer task light was publicly relaunched as a popular product close to the core offer, so prior commitment and established demand favor keeping it despite its age.

The pendant office luminaire is close to the core offer and recently launched with its own page, and any weak results can still be attributed to temporary pandemic-related demand in office construction.
The premium pendant line with several models represents substantial investment close to the core LED offer, so management would persist and attribute any shortfall to temporary market conditions.
